We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR? Probably need to get proton NMR and count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string? Actually function signature: proton_nmr_spectra takes {} no args. It measures for sample at hand. So we can call it. Then analyze peaks: methyl groups appear as singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9-1.5 ppm, integration corresponds to 3H. But we only get string of spectrum, maybe includes peaks with integration? Not sure. Could also use carbon NMR to count methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra. Then count number of signals in that region.

Simplify: call proton_nmr_spectra.
